import inspect

import pytest

import solution
from solution import harmonic_sum


def test_issue_example_7():
    """Example: harmonic_sum(7) == 2.5928571428571425."""
    # 1/1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/4 + 1/5 + 1/6 + 1/7 = 2.5928571428571425
    assert harmonic_sum(7) == 2.5928571428571425


def test_issue_n1():
    """Harmonic sum harmonic_sum(1) is 1.0."""
    # 1/1 = 1.0
    assert harmonic_sum(1) == pytest.approx(1.0)


def test_issue_n2():
    """Harmonic sum harmonic_sum(2) is 1.5."""
    # 1/1 + 1/2 = 1.5
    assert harmonic_sum(2) == pytest.approx(1.5)


def test_issue_n3():
    """Harmonic sum harmonic_sum(3) is 11/6."""
    # 1/1 + 1/2 + 1/3 = 11/6 = 1.8333333333333333
    assert harmonic_sum(3) == pytest.approx(1.8333333333333333)


def test_issue_n4():
    """Harmonic sum harmonic_sum(4) is 25/12."""
    # 1/1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/4 = 25/12 = 2.083333333333333
    assert harmonic_sum(4) == pytest.approx(2.083333333333333)


def test_issue_n5():
    """Harmonic sum harmonic_sum(5) is 137/60."""
    # 1/1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/4 + 1/5 = 137/60 = 2.283333333333333
    assert harmonic_sum(5) == pytest.approx(2.283333333333333)


def test_issue_n8():
    """Harmonic sum harmonic_sum(8) adds 1/8 to the example."""
    # 1/1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/4 + 1/5 + 1/6 + 1/7 + 1/8 = 2.7178571428571425
    assert harmonic_sum(8) == pytest.approx(2.7178571428571425)


def test_issue_n10():
    """Harmonic sum harmonic_sum(10) sums reciprocals 1 to 10."""
    # 1/1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/4 + 1/5 + 1/6 + 1/7 + 1/8 + 1/9 + 1/10 = 2.9289682539682538
    assert harmonic_sum(10) == pytest.approx(2.9289682539682538)


def test_issue_n100():
    """Harmonic sum harmonic_sum(100) sums reciprocals 1 to 100."""
    # sum(1/k for k=1..100) = 5.187377517639621
    assert harmonic_sum(100) == pytest.approx(5.187377517639621)


def test_contract_function_exists():
    """Public interface requires solution.harmonic_sum to exist."""
    assert callable(solution.harmonic_sum)


def test_contract_single_parameter():
    """Public interface defines harmonic_sum(n) with one parameter."""
    assert len(inspect.signature(harmonic_sum).parameters) == 1


def test_contract_returns_float():
    """Example result 2.5928571428571425 is a float."""
    # harmonic_sum(7) == 2.5928571428571425, a float literal
    assert isinstance(harmonic_sum(7), float)
